The selected drawable version is recorded per setting state.

The constructor-return bytes are captured before this ObjectStroke is applied; they are raw state, not asserted to be a Samsung device default. `Pen::GetSize()` is observed on a separately constructed Pencil3 before stroke application; the model default getter is also recorded before setters; the selected tool remains explicit synthetic input.

Native Pen::SetScreenResolution and Pen::getSettingData execute against the explicit IContext profile supplied 1920x1080 before AddPoint; identity color conversion, flags/version, canvases, bitmap/resource adapters, and task-queue registration are host stubs.
